title: net1 on a hit's concepts
description: Step 4, second of three experiments: net1 learns the hit's concepts from the step data of the input data (an experiments/concepts-data.json release, which names the hit and holds net1's spec on its concepts, concepts.json, with a note of them, concepts.md), with the estimator's settings: a distribution over 64 bins, three members, width 512, dropout 0.05, the same 70 measurements. Rows are every 12th step, split by link (seed 1, 15% validation, 15% test), BBRv3, Westwood and threshold-0.3 held out of training and reported apart (experiments/net1_train.py). Reported per concept: 90% coverage, R^2 and log loss on the validation and test links and on the held-out controllers. Nothing is chosen here: the one net1 is the input of experiments/concepts-controller.json.
